summary: Rounds the corners of the box, its background and its border.
details: One value rounds every corner; four values go clockwise from top-left. 50% on a square makes a circle; a very large value such as 999px on a wider box makes a pill whatever its size.

values.note: A circle (on a square box) or an ellipse.
A pill: fully rounded ends at any width.

gotcha: Rounded corners do not clip the children: an image or coloured header inside still pokes out of the corners. Add overflow: hidden to the rounded element.
